text:
luke_csm: Heads-up 0 Concordia QBR next Wed 9am PT. Finance wants a one-slide token econ + runway and a short mitigation plan. Who can own numbers?

mira_cs: I got the forecast. Will pull 7/30/90 cohorts and do status_quo vs optimized.

noah_se: Noted. After their last deploy rerank now fans out; embedding calls spiked. I'll pull top routes and estimated savings from caching + dedupe.

alert_bot: infra-alert: account=concordia daily_tokens=1.9M @2026-08-11T03:10:00Z 0 budget_alert triggered.

tara_fin: Finance flag: projected spend (status_quo) ~= $4.6k/mo. If they take a 3mo small dedicated it's approx $3.4k/mo. Need sensitivity table and credits-runway.

mira_cs: Draft quick playbook for slide: 1) Immediate: enable prefix_kv on history routes + set soft alert at 1.3M/day; 2) 1 week: enable batching (150-200ms) for bulk embed jobs; 3) 2-4 weeks: trial quantized rerank on mirror traffic; 4) Offer 3mo commit with onboarding credit.

noah_se: SQL I used for top callers:```sql
SELECT route, sum(tokens) AS tokens, count(*) AS calls
FROM usage
WHERE account='concordia' AND time >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

tara_fin: I'll produce status_quo v optimized sensitivity table and show credits_left vs days_to_exhaustion. Also draft commit tiers (1/3/6 months).

mira_cs: Action items: (1) @mira_cs post forecast + slide by EOD tomorrow; (2) @noah_se attach top-10 route table + % savings; (3) @tara_fin prepare sensitivity + commit tiers; (4) I'll draft talking points for the QBR.

luke_csm: Great. If we can show a clear ~30% savings case and a low-friction pilot (A/B 25% traffic), we should move this from watch -> healthy. Thx :thumbsup:

(ends)
